metadata.title: LunarLab: software, study records and trained policies for auditable reward-design experiments
metadata.description:
Software and research data for LunarLab, a toolkit for auditable reward-design experiments in reinforcement learning, prepared for a software article (manuscript in preparation).

  • source/: the LunarLab repository at revision a38d07f59f99dee53676b061955d25e8caef3e72 (see REVISIONS.md): the library whose code is that of revision c9b9384, tests, documentation, protocols, study records, the audit-workflow comparison programs and fixtures, and results;
  • software/: deterministic, installable source archives;
  • lunarlander-study/: the historical 38-policy LunarLander export (3,800 recorded test episodes; the six learned-reward packages with their original reward models) and its repair-time source archive;
  • cartpole-study-output/: the CartPole study's 36 frozen checkpoints and 18 exported audit artifacts, and an inventory of the 156 scheduled checkpoints that are not distributed;
  • outside-git/: the 14 policies of the comparison fixtures.

START_HERE.md explains how to check the archive from a fresh extraction with the included validator, which installs locked dependencies into a new environment and uses an empty data home. Nothing is trained.

Limitations: only nine of the 38 LunarLander policies have been replayed on Linux; bit-identical results across operating systems are not a supported guarantee; the LunarLander policies were trained from a modified working tree based on revision 32823f3, as their records state; no independent person has yet used LunarLab.
